title.narrative: Supporting Access to Education Needs for Crisis Affected Communities in Machakel. Enemay and Sedea woredas of East Gojam Zone,Amhara Region

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe ongoing conflict in the Amhara region, creating a volatile and unpredictable security situation. As a result, school enrollment and attendance have declined significantly. Of the 6.8 million children targeted for enrollment in the 2024/2025 academic year, only 2.7 million had enrolled by January 2025, leaving 4.2 million children out of school, which accounts for 60.9% of the regional enrollment target. Therefore, this project aims to enhance access to equitable and inclusive accelerated education for 1730 children with disabilities in Machakel, Enemay and Sedea Woredas of East Gojam Zone, Amhara Regional State. The project aligns with the 2025 HRP first standard allocation under the title "Lifesaving Humanitarian Assistance for People Affected by Critical Malnutrition, Gender-Based Violence, and Education Needs." ltbrgtThe project integrates inclusive education strategies, ensuring that children with disabilities receive the necessary support and resources to fully participate in accelerated education. This includes tailored teaching methods, specialized learning materials, and teacher training focused on adaptive and inclusive pedagogy. The project outputs include:ltbrgt Output 1: Children with disabilities are identified, enrolled, and retained in accelerated or catch-up education programs.ltbrgt Output 2: Education institutions, partners, and communities in the selected Woredas receive support to deliver quality, crisis-sensitive, and disability-inclusive education for affected children.ltbrgt Output 3: Crisis-affected children with disabilities gain increased access to safe, inclusive, and protective formal and non-formal learning opportunities.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
